subject.title: fix(agents): honor Anthropic Retry-After in auto-retry backoff (#103849)

question: Should oversized Anthropic Retry-After values suppress the affected auth profile for MAX_TIMER_TIMEOUT_MS, and should httpStatus/retryAfter become shared AssistantMessage fields?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and exact-head proof is sufficient, but these choices define cross-runtime API and profile-availability policy that tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept shared fields; use a finite bound
options.body: Keep the structured end-to-end contract and cap unusable values at an owner-approved transient cooldown.

options.title: Accept the current maximum hold
options.body: Keep the shared fields and intentionally suppress the profile for roughly 24.8 days on oversized numeric headers.

options.title: Keep metadata runtime-local
options.body: Preserve the behavior fix while avoiding shared AssistantMessage fields if owners do not want this contract.

recommendation.title: Accept shared fields; use a finite bound
recommendation.body: Keep the structured end-to-end contract and cap unusable values at an owner-approved transient cooldown.

likelyOwner.reason: Pre-boundary history most strongly connects this person to the Anthropic transport and broader agent runtime affected by both decisions.
